title: 第19章 到这个房间睡吧第20章 万兽山脉妖兽异动
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第19章到这个房间睡吧
江尘破开七脉的异像，已经惊动了整个天武城，无数居民浩浩荡荡聚集而来，更有修为有成的武者飞檐走壁，想亲眼见证破开七脉的天骄是谁，
不过半刻功夫，街头巷尾已经挤满了人，
就连开店的店家和青楼的姑娘都也被吸引了过来，这片街道从未有过如此繁华的景象，就连房檐上此时也站满了人，
所有人呆呆的望着那道身影，不敢相信眼前发生的事，那个破开七脉的绝代天骄，竟然是被嘲笑数年的江尘？
很多人悔的肠子都青了，因为早在半个月前，江尘曾四处找人求婚，而此时他们目光中再也没有了曾经的轻蔑，变成了深深的震撼和仰望，
凝气破七脉，更是越八个小境界战胜云霞宗弟子，这都是世间难见的神迹，
江尘身上，已经有了一丝神话般的色彩，给所有人留下了不可磨灭的震撼印象。
“天才，他是真正的武道天才，未来必定能成为一方强者！”
“别说天武城，放在东荒，都是天纵奇才，难怪他二十岁才凝气，唯有积累底蕴，磨砺己身，才有了今天一鸣惊人的机会！”
“乱世之中必有天才诞生，再过几十年，江尘一定能够成为人族至强者之一！”
“被人嘲讽这么多年，却不发一言，隐锋芒于其内，不光天赋，他的心性坚韧，城府之深，简直可怕！
这等奇才，平生仅见！”
江尘推开涌上来的人群，看到了谢三刀几人，谢三刀一接触到江尘的眼神，顿时全身一缩，瑟瑟发抖，眼中满是惊恐和畏惧，
之前就不是江尘的对手，此时江尘凝气开七脉，无异于一跃化龙，可以说杀了他们几人也不会有人敢管。
外围，南宫婉儿的一直提着的心终于放下，她眼中含着点点泪水，不知为何，刚刚她一颗心都挂在了江尘身上，生怕他出了意外，没想到，江尘竟从如此逆境中凝气，更是一举破开七脉，
她从没想到，曾经那个看起来平平无奇的男人，竟然会在一个月的时间成长到这种地步。
“小丫头，他是你男人？”
一个形容枯槁的老头向她蹒跚而来，
南宫婉儿心中突然升起一股警惕，

那老头走的很慢，可每一步都似乎踏在了南宫婉儿心弦之上，
但这种压抑感觉很快消失，再看不过是一落魄老头的模样，
老头紧了紧麻衣，靠在江尘家门口缓缓坐下，
“还别说，你找男人的眼光挺好，这是你家院墙？让坐不？”
南宫婉儿点点头，
那枯瘦老者倚在墙边，沉浸在温暖阳光之下，似是慢慢睡去。
茶馆二楼，
林寒看着去而复返的吴铭，神情阴沉无比，
“怎么？你也怕了？不敢杀破开七脉的天才？”
吴铭似是心有余悸，似是刚刚从什么大恐怖中逃脱出来，额头冷汗涔涔，半晌才蹦出一句，
“林师兄，有强者降临，快走！”
...
夜幕降临。
今天是江海一生中最扬眉吐气的一天，
随着他年纪越来越大，他对自己的这个孙子越来越不放心，他时常在想，江尘没了父亲，若自己再离开这个世界，江尘一个人该怎么生活，
这些年来，为了他这个一无是处的孙子，他一直倾尽全力守护，
第19章到这个房间睡吧
content_en:
Chapter 19 Let’s sleep in this room
Jiang Chen's vision of breaking the seven meridians has alarmed the entire Tianwu City. Countless residents gathered in a mighty manner, and even accomplished warriors climbed up the walls to see with their own eyes who the genius was who broke the seven meridians.
In just a short moment, the streets and alleys were already crowded with people.
Even the shopkeepers and the girls from the brothels were attracted. This street has never been so prosperous. Even the eaves were full of people.
Everyone stared blankly at the figure, unable to believe what was happening in front of them. The peerless genius who broke through the seven meridians was actually Jiang Chen, who had been ridiculed for several years?
Many people regretted that their intestines were green, because as early as half a month ago, Jiang Chen had been looking for someone to propose to him, and now their eyes no longer had the contempt they once had, but instead turned into deep shock and admiration.
Condensing Qi to break the seven meridians, and even defeating Yunxia Sect disciples across eight small realms, these are miracles rarely seen in the world.
Jiang Chen already had a touch of mythical color, leaving an indelible and shocking impression on everyone.
"Genius, he is a true martial arts genius, and he will definitely become a strong man in the future!"
"Don't talk about Tianwu City, in the Eastern Wasteland, they are all geniuses. No wonder he only gathered his energy at the age of twenty. Only by accumulating knowledge and honing himself can he have the opportunity to become a blockbuster today!"
"Geniuses must be born in troubled times. In a few decades, Jiang Chen will definitely become one of the strongest people in the human race!"
"Having been ridiculed for so many years, yet he didn't say a word. His talent is hidden within him. Not only his talent, but also his tenacity and the depth of his city are simply terrifying!
This kind of genius is something you only see in your life! "
Jiang Chen pushed aside the crowd that came up and saw Xie Sandao and the others. As soon as Xie Sandao met Jiang Chen's eyes, his whole body shrank and trembled. His eyes were full of panic and fear.
He was no match for Jiang Chen before, but now Jiang Chen condensed his energy and opened his seven meridians, which was like turning into a dragon in one leap. It could be said that even if he killed several of them, no one would dare to care.
On the periphery, Nangong Wan'er's heart that she had been holding finally let go, and there were a few tears in her eyes. For some reason, her heart was focused on Jiang Chen just now, for fear that something might happen to him. Unexpectedly, Jiang Chen gathered his energy from such adversity, and even broke through the seven meridians in one fell swoop.
She never thought that the man who once seemed ordinary would grow to this point in a month.
"Little girl, is he your man?"
A haggard old man staggered toward her.
Nangong Wan'er suddenly felt vigilant in her heart,
The old man walked very slowly, but every step seemed to step on Nangong Wan'er's heartstrings.
But this depressing feeling quickly disappeared, and he looked like a down-and-out old man again.
The old man tightened his linen clothes and slowly sat down against the door of Jiang Chen's house.
"Don't mention it, you have a good eye for men. This is your courtyard wall? Can you give me a seat?"
Nangong Wan'er nodded,
The skinny old man was leaning against the wall, immersed in the warm sunshine, and seemed to be slowly falling asleep.
The second floor of the teahouse,
Lin Han looked at Wu Ming who had left and returned with a gloomy expression.
"What? Are you afraid too? Don't you dare to kill the genius who has broken through the seven meridians?"
Wu Ming seemed to have lingering fears, as if he had just escaped from some great terror. Cold sweat was dripping from his forehead, and it took him a long time to say,
"Senior Brother Lin, a strong man is coming, hurry up!"
...
Night falls.
Today is the most proud day in Jiang Hai’s life.
As he got older, he became more and more worried about his grandson. He often thought about how Jiang Chen would live alone if Jiang Chen lost his father.
Over the years, he has tried his best to protect his worthless grandson.
